# Camp objects

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_wiki.py from Campkeeper/Data/Catalog.lua and tools/wiki_objects.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every campfire and camp object in *World of Warcraft: Forever*, as the Campkeeper catalog knows them. Data from the beta client 1.60.1; numbers can still change before launch. In game the names come from your client, so they are in your language.

## Campfires

A campfire is the heart of a camp: every other object needs one nearby. All fires are made with Cooking.

| Campfire | Cooking | Places for objects |
|---|---|---|
| Basic Campfire | 1 | 3 |
| Journeyman Campfire | 140 | 5 |
| Expert Campfire | 220 | 10 |

## Bonuses at a glance

The first-tier object of most professions gives a stat bonus to everyone who sits by the fire. Each bonus is mutually exclusive with one class buff: you get one or the other, not both. Campkeeper marks such objects in the camp panel and the planner skips them when the group has that class.

| Profession | Object | Bonus | Does not stack with |
|---|---|---|---|
| Alchemy | Mana Well | 10 mana every 5 sec. | Blessing of Wisdom |
| Blacksmithing | Sharpening Wheel | +6 Strength. | Strength of Earth Totem |
| Enchanting | Enchanted Lute | +71 Armor and +2 to all stats. | Mark of the Wild |
| First Aid | First Aid Kit | +8 Stamina. | Power Word: Fortitude |
| Fishing | Fish Bowl | +8% to all stats. | Blessing of Kings |
| Herbalism | Incense Candle | +6 Intellect. | Arcane Intellect |
| Mining | Lodestone | +20 melee Attack Power. | Blessing of Might |
| Skinning | Camp Chair | +2% critical strike chance with spells and attacks. | Moonkin Aura |
| Tailoring | Faction Banner | +14 Spirit. Alliance and Horde have their own banner. | Divine Spirit |

Higher tiers placed over a first-tier object keep its bonus, so you lose nothing by upgrading.

## By profession

Skill is the profession skill needed to make and place the object.

### Alchemy

| Tier | Object | Skill | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Mana Well | 20 | 10 mana every 5 sec. Does not stack with Blessing of Wisdom. |
| 2 | Fermenter | 140 | Lets you create certain reagents. Also gives the Mana Well bonus; place it over the Mana Well to upgrade. |
| 3 | Alchemy Laboratory | 300 | Required to craft certain items. Also gives the Mana Well bonus; place it over the Mana Well to upgrade. |

## Rules that apply to every object

- All camping items share **one cooldown of 1 hour** per character.
- An object needs a campfire nearby, and the fire has a limited number of places (see above).
- Bonuses come from sitting by the fire for 1 minute; they last 1 hour as **Camp Benefits**.

See also: [[Camping guide|Camping-Guide]].
